personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A hyper-clean, premium discovery experience that blends Apple's typographic clarity, Airbnb's warm photography, and Uber's high-contrast utility.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-style padding. Let content breathe. Use safe areas diligently.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers when content scrolls behind.
Use glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky 'Book Now' bottom containers.
Use glass on floating map controls.
dont's: Do not use glass on standard list cards.
Do not use glass over body text.

screens.name: Home / Discovery
screens.purpose: A premium hub to discover the best of the selected city across 20+ verticals.

states.empty: Illustration of a map with 'No places found' and clear filters CTA.
states.error: Clean text 'Unable to load city data' with a 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with City Selector (left) and User Avatar (right). A cinematic hero card featuring the selected city (e.g. Goa/Pune) with a gradient scrim. Below hero, a horizontally scrolling row of Pill/Chip categories (Restaurants, Hotels, Events, etc.). Followed by vertically scrolling curated sections ('Trending this week', 'Luxury Stays') with large, high-quality image cards. Cards use width '100%' minus padding or multi-col grid with proper spacing.

screens.name: Map & Search
screens.purpose: Interactive spatial discovery of nearby places with smart filters.

states.empty: Map empty state with 'Try expanding your search radius'.
states.error: Failed to load map data error message.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map view. Floating glass search bar at the top (with safe area). Floating glass action buttons (filters, locate me) on the right. A Gorhom bottom sheet containing the list of visible places. When the sheet is pulled up, the map dims slightly.

screens.name: Business Profile
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific business with high-conversion booking intent.

states.loading: Image skeleton and text skeleton blocks.

screens.layout: Full-bleed image header (with parallax if possible). Back button is a frosted glass circle. Below image: Title, Rating, Address. Scrollable content area with tabs or distinct sections for Photos, Menu/Services, Reviews. At the very bottom, a sticky glass container anchored above the safe area holding a prominent 'Book Now' / 'Reserve' primary button (Uber style).

screens.name: Booking / Reservation Flow

states.empty: No slots available for selected date.

screens.layout: Presented as a modal or dedicated clean screen. Large typography for step titles ('Select Date & Time', 'Guest Details'). Form inputs have labels above, clean 1px borders on focus. 'Continue' button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Wallet & Profile
screens.purpose: Manage rewards, saved places, and account settings.
screens.layout: Notion-style index layout. Top section features a 'Reward Points' card with a subtle gradient (brandPrimary to slightly lighter black). Below it, clean list rows for 'Saved Places', 'My Bookings', 'Payment Methods', 'Settings'. Each row has a leading icon and a trailing chevron.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow 1 iOS-Native Clean combined with 6 Glass/Luxe for a premium, high-end feel.
Do NOT use any blues or purples. We are using an Uber/Notion inspired near-black (#1A1A1A) as the primary action color, paired with a warm Terra-cotta (#E27D60) for subtle tertiary accents.
Implement the 'Book Now' button as a sticky element at the bottom of the Place Profile screen. It must float above the scrollable content inside a glass container.
Images MUST use a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) if text is layered on top of them. This is non-negotiable for hero cards.
Ensure safe area padding is respected, especially around the glass headers and bottom tabs.
Do not use emojis in the UI. Use Ionicons consistently (either all outlined or all filled per screen, except the tab bar).
